title: shapewise-presets-and-quant-rollback-cli
author: Priya Shah
release_notes: Add shape-aware tenant presets for batching/caching; introduce `rw quant rollback` CLI and safe canary rollout for quantized model variants. No behavioral API changes; opt-in via tenant defaults or CLI.
description: Context: Customers frequently have mixed traffic shapes (short prompts vs long mult-turn chats) which single global defaults struggle to optimize. This PR adds a lightweight shape-aware defaults engine plus a safe CLI-driven quantization rollout/rollback flow that ties into unit-econ simulation and canary routing. Motivation: reduce per-token cost and tail latency regressions by automatically selecting batch and cache presets based on observed request shape, while making quantized rollouts reversible and observable. Summary of changes: 1) Shape classifier that derives request shape fingerprints (short/medium/long, seq-delta distribution) and maps them to recommended batch sizes, cache TTL, and KV prefill heuristics. 2) Presets-as-code: a new tenant-level config schema (yaml) allowing shape->preset mappings and an import CLI to seed tenant defaults. 3) Quant rollout CLI: `rw quant promote|canary|rollback` that stages quantized model variants with traffic weights, automatically creates a canary route, and wires unit-econ simulator runs to validate cost/latency tradeoffs before ramp. 4) Safety controls: automatic regression detector (simple latency + quality thresholds) that will rollback a canary if SLOs or unit-econ deltas exceed thresholds. 5) Observability hooks: emits new telemetry namespaces (prefill.presets, quant.rollout) and a short-lived debug trace for canaries. 6) Tests: unit tests for the classifier, e2e smoke test for CLI flow, and a simulated workload test that exercises the canary rollback path. Backwards compatibility: defaults are opt-in; existing tenant configs remain unchanged until an operator imports presets. Linear/jira: ENG-4219 (shape-aware defaults), ENG-4301 (quant-rollout CLI), SUP-9821 (customer support follow-up). Checklist: - [x] Shape classifier implementation and docs - [x] Presets-as-code schema + import CLI - [x] Quant rollout + rollback implementation - [x] Unit-econ simulation hookup for canary validation - [x] CI tests added - [x] Integration tests for rollback path - [x] Docs snippet in console runbook (deferred to a follow-up PR for full docs)

+def fingerprint(req):

+    return {"bucket": 'short' if len(req.tokens)<64 else 'long' }

review_comments: Ethan Liu: Nice separation of concerns. Two asks: (1) make the fingerprint deterministic across SDK versions (add schema version), (2) ensure telemetry keys are low-cardinality. Please add tests for schema versioning.
Priya Shah: Added schema version field and unit tests for fingerprint stability. Telemetry keys moved under prefill.presets.{bucket}. Kept cardinality to 3 buckets.

Mariana Costa: CLI UX looks good. Request: expose a dry-run that only runs the unit-econ sim and prints summary without touching routing. Also add clearer error messages if canary creation fails due to quota.
Priya Shah: Implemented --dry-run and improved error handling; added a simulation-only mode to the canary path. Added quota check with a friendlier message.
Oliver Grant: LGTM pending small nits in tests and one doc sentence about why presets are opt-in. Tests fixed and doc sentence added.
